description: Fetch affiliation records for an ORCID researcher. The `types` parameter controls which affiliation sections to return: employment, education, invited-positions, distinctions, memberships, qualifications, services, or all. Default is employment and education. Returns organization names, disambiguated organization identifiers (ROR/GRID/Ringgold), departments, roles, date ranges, and sources. Affiliations come from the researcher or from member organizations such as a university research information system; sources names who added each, and selfAsserted tells the two apart. Absence does not mean no affiliation.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

types.description: Which affiliation types to return. Defaults to employment and education. Use ["all"] to get every section.

items.description: Affiliation section type. Use "all" to include all section types.

name: orcid_get_affiliations

affiliationCount.description: Total number of affiliation records returned.

affiliations.description: Affiliation records for the requested types.

department.description: Department or unit within the organization.

endDate.description: End date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD). Absent if current.

disambiguatedId.description: Disambiguated organization identifier (ROR URL, GRID ID, or Ringgold ID).

disambiguationSource.description: Source of the disambiguation (ROR, GRID, or RINGGOLD).

sources.description: The party that added this affiliation to the ORCID record — the researcher, or a member organization such as a university research information system. Empty when ORCID records no source.

items.description: A party that asserted this item on the ORCID record.

assertionOriginName.description: Party the source added the item on behalf of, when ORCID records one — usually the researcher, for an item added through a search-and-link tool.

name.description: Name of the person or member organization system that added the item (e.g. a university research information system, Crossref, Scopus - Elsevier). Absent when ORCID records no name.

selfAsserted.description: True when the asserting party (the assertion origin when recorded, otherwise the source) is the requested ORCID iD; false when a member organization or another ORCID user asserted the item.

type.description: Affiliation section type (employment, education, invited-positions, etc.).

url.description: URL for the affiliation record, if provided.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Note when no affiliations were found — they may be private, or neither the researcher nor a member organization added any.

title: Get ORCID Researcher Affiliations
